title: Repeat the move for staging, then production
description: After development is cut over and stable: bootstrap-and-role (already done per account by the first card), then the environment deploy, verification and cutover for chatticus-staging and chatticus-production, in that order. Production also needs a data and Cognito user plan (users cannot be exported with passwords; Google federation re-links by email). Do not start until development has run in its new account for a while.
